steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Boss... you... are injured...

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: It's nothing. I'll sleep it off.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...Did I make it?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Right on time... Hehe, I knew you would come...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: ...Kept inside the stone altar is the source of those crystals... the source of those weapons... They want to take it and use it against you.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Horo, the Legion will not lose.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I know, Commander, you're the strongest... You always lead the charge. In every battle, you're always at the head of the group... Legion is what it is today because of you.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: ...That's why I want to... be part of your strength...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Commander... I've guarded the inheritance. Take it with you.
The murmurs of the chaotic voice come back. This time, you detect the source. It's located at the other end of the shackles. Zoya has heard the bewitchment mingled in Horo's words.
...Come on... This is the power that you desire...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: You need its power... Once you possess it, there will be no need to fear the tricks of those bastards, and there will be no more unnecessary loss of life.

steps.speaker: Horo?
steps.content: Mania Crystals... Powerful weapons... Unstoppable power... They'll be all yours...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: No one can get in our way... Syndicate will change, we are finally able to change it...

steps.speaker: Horo?
steps.content: You were born to wreak destruction, you need stronger power that can destroy everything. Don't you want to destroy everything?

steps.speaker: Horo?
steps.content: <size=44><color=#dg1f1f>Come on! It's here, here!</color></size>
The inheritance is controlling Horo to tempt Zoya!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief...

steps.speaker: Concentration of Contamination
steps.content: Keep out... Keep out...
You instinctively make to stop it, but the filthy sludge ensnares your ankles. It transforms into the shape of Horo slowly and immobilizes all of you.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You got yourself all these cuts and bruises... It isn't just about its power, is it?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Horo, what do you fear?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I... Ugh!
Horo coughs up blood after receiving a heavy blow. Zoya's eyes are red with anger. The murmurs of the bewitchment die down, but the red light coming out of the stone altar is growing blighter.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I fear...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: The moment I saw it, I knew... We can't win... The voice has found its way to my brain. I can't resist all the things it tells me.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I saw with my own eyes how it turned Sinners into monsters. It only took a second, and the Sinners were gone... This is the source, the source of Mania, the source of us.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: If it falls into the hands of our enemies... if they use it against you... If even you will...

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Horo...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I don't want to see that happen! I-I don't want to! If you are defeated, the Legion will be no more! I don't want to see you fall! This time around I'm prepared to do anything to prevent that!

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I don't want to see any of you fall down in front of me anymore!
At the other end of the shackles, Zoya hesitates.
This is a cry from within Horo herself, not something she has been manipulated or bewitched to saying. This is the darkest trap set by the inheritance; Horo's cry has made Zoya waver.
At this moment, a crack runs down the altar, like a hungry gaping mouth. Countless tentacles crawl out of the crack and towards Zoya.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The inheritance wants to devour them?!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: No, that thing, it is... craving for Zoya!

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: <size=44><color=#dg1f1f>Take it with you!!</color></size>
The red light bounces off Zoya and takes on a hue that is dazzling and frightening. A stubborn consciousness inside you is shouting...
Stop her!
Tens of red beams protrude from Zoya's body, nailing her to the spot. Finally, she looks up at you.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You... you are using the shackles on me?

options: Yes. You must resist it. I'll not allow you to succumb to it.
